provisions.cite: IRS Publication 550, Inflation-Indexed Debt Instruments (inflation adjustments to TIPS principal are taxable each year as OID; 26 CFR 1.1275-7)
provisions.quote: If you hold an inflation-indexed debt instrument (other than a series I U.S. savings bond), you must report as OID any increase in the inflation-adjusted principal amount of the instrument that occurs while you held the instrument during the year.
These securities pay interest twice a year at a fixed rate, based on a principal amount adjusted to take into account inflation and deflation.
